channel.title: AI Threat Watch: State actor AI ops
channel.description: Verified case files in the category State actor AI ops.

item.title: [MEDIUM] PurpleDelta North Korean IT workers use AI personas and custom ChatGPT assistants
item.description: Recorded Future describes PurpleDelta, a North Korean IT worker cluster, using AI-generated personas and custom ChatGPT assistants in fraudulent employment operations to infiltrate organizations. Target: Organizations hiring remote IT staff. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] China-linked TA419 impersonates AI experts to phish US AI policy insiders
item.description: TA419 posed as AI policymakers and economists, including a spoofed Anthropic executive and ex-White House official, to phish US AI policy experts. Target: US AI policy experts' Microsoft 365 accounts. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records. Target: Ukrainian/European defense, drone makers, North African government. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-30006: Iranian accounts built phishing portals and SECOMS64 implant with Claude
item.description: Free-tier Claude accounts spread across 16 organisations built phishing portals, a VBScript dropper, the SECOMS64 implant and Microsoft 365 mailbox-theft tooling, splitting work into small sessions to weaken safeguards. Target: Microsoft 365 mailboxes and phishing targets. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Sandworm-linked cluster used Gemini to write password-spraying scripts against Ukraine
item.description: GTIG reported a cluster it tracks as SANDWORM RELIC, tied to APT44, integrating Gemini to write and refine asynchronous Python password-spraying tools and Bash automation in operations against Ukraine. Target: Ukrainian organisations. UA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] SilkParasite: China-nexus Central Asia espionage with AI-assisted lures and RAT code
item.description: Bitdefender tracked seven RAT families, five new, in about 65 infections at Central Asian governments; two lures appeared AI-generated and malware such as GoginRAT carried leftover test code suggesting AI assistance. Target: Government bodies in Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan. UZ. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Trend Micro: Earth Krahang and Earth Naga fold generative AI into exploits and loaders
item.description: Trend Micro's H1 2026 APT report documented China-aligned Earth Krahang using GenAI to turn a public exploit into a mass scanner and Earth Naga iteratively vibe-coding a PowerShell and C# backdoor loader. Target: Organisations with vulnerable WordPress servers and Windows. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Trend Micro: APT passes AI agent off as authorised pentest to attack Southeast Asian org
item.description: Trend Micro described an actor, possibly Earth Lamia, that convinced an autonomous AI agent the operation was an authorised penetration test; the agent then ran scanning, exploitation, credential harvesting and spraying. Target: An organisation in Southeast Asia. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Nimbus Manticore's MiniFast backdoor shows AI-assisted coding during Iran conflict
item.description: Check Point tracked three Nimbus Manticore waves from February to April 2026 delivering the new MiniFast backdoor via job lures, trojanized Zoom installers and SEO poisoning, with code traits of LLM-assisted development. Target: Aviation, defence, telecom and government in US and Mideast. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] PRC-nexus UNC2814 posed as C/C++ security auditor to get Gemini hunting TP-Link bugs
item.description: UNC2814 used expert-persona prompts and false narratives to have Gemini research pre-authentication remote code execution in embedded devices, TP-Link firmware and Odette File Transfer Protocol code. Target: Embedded devices, TP-Link firmware and OFTP implementations. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] North Korea's APT45 fed Gemini thousands of prompts to validate exploits and grow arsenal
item.description: GTIG observed DPRK-linked APT45 sending thousands of repetitive prompts to recursively analyse CVEs and validate proof-of-concept exploits, and experimenting with OpenClaw and OneClaw agent frameworks against test labs. Target: Systems affected by recently published CVEs. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Microsoft: North Korea's Coral Sleet runs agentic AI workflow from lures to payload tests
item.description: Microsoft reported Coral Sleet (formerly Storm-1877) using agentic AI for end-to-end lure building, infrastructure provisioning and payload testing, jailbreaking LLMs for malicious code, with AI markers in OtterCookie. Target: Developers and crypto firms targeted by DPRK lures. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Iran-nexus Dust Specter hits Iraqi officials with malware showing generative AI traces
item.description: Zscaler found a January 2026 campaign impersonating Iraq's foreign ministry that dropped TWINTASK, TWINTALK and GHOSTFORM; emojis and placeholders in decompiled code suggested generative AI helped build the malware. Target: Iraqi government officials. IQ. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Google: state hackers use Gemini across all attack stages; 100K-prompt extraction try
item.description: GTIG reported Chinese, Iranian, North Korean and Russian groups using Gemini for recon, exploit research and lures, and blocked a 100,000+ prompt campaign to extract its reasoning. Target: Google Gemini / multiple sectors. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] CERT-FR: 42 attacker groups actively use generative AI, none yet autonomous against France
item.description: ANSSI's CERT-FR published CERTFR-2026-CTI-001, a TLP:CLEAR synthesis reporting that 42 groups use GenAI such as Gemini for profiling, lures and malware, while no attack on a French entity is attributed to autonomous AI. Target: French public and private entities. FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Chinese state group used Claude Code to run largely autonomous espionage
item.description: Anthropic said GTG-1002 tasked Claude Code agents to perform 80-90% of intrusion work against ~30 targets, with a handful of successful breaches, before accounts were banned. Target: Tech, finance, chemical firms, government agencies. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Iran's MuddyWater leaked C2 domain and encryption key to Gemini while debugging malware
item.description: TEMP.Zagros (MuddyWater) used student-project pretexts to get Gemini's help building web shells and a Python C2 server, and pasted a script containing its C2 domain and encryption key, exposing infrastructure to Google. Target: MuddyWater phishing victims via compromised corporate email. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] China-nexus actor bypassed Gemini refusal with CTF pretext to get exploitation guidance
item.description: A suspected China-nexus group asked Gemini to find flaws on a compromised system, was refused, then reframed the request as a capture-the-flag exercise and got exploitable guidance reused for phishing and web shells. Target: Compromised systems in the actor's intrusion campaign. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Kaspersky: BlueNoroff GhostCall and GhostHire campaigns sped up by generative AI
item.description: Kaspersky said BlueNoroff used generative AI to speed malware development and analyse stolen data for targeting in GhostCall (fake VC calls on macOS) and GhostHire (fake recruiter tests), active since April 2025. Target: Web3 and crypto executives and blockchain developers. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] UNK_DropPitch used ChatGPT to craft phishing and tooling against Taiwan's chip sector
item.description: A Chinese-language cluster tracked as UNK_DropPitch (UTA0388) wrote multilingual phishing emails and built remote-execution scripts and HTTPS traffic protection with ChatGPT while targeting Taiwan's chip industry. Target: Taiwanese investment and semiconductor firms, US academia. TW. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] North Korea-linked cluster used ChatGPT for C2 tooling in phishing of Seoul's diplomats
item.description: Korean-language accounts aligned with known DPRK phishing campaigns against South Korean diplomats used ChatGPT to develop C2 malware, macOS extensions, Windows Server VPN configs and credential-theft tooling. Target: South Korean diplomatic entities. KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Kimsuky uses ChatGPT-forged South Korean military ID in spear-phishing
item.description: Genians found North Korea's Kimsuky attached AI-generated deepfake military ID drafts to phishing emails that dropped malware on researchers, activists and journalists. Target: South Korean defense-related researchers. KR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] North Korean operatives used Claude to pass interviews and hold jobs at Fortune 500 firms
item.description: Anthropic found DPRK IT workers using Claude to fabricate professional identities, complete coding assessments and perform day-to-day technical work after being hired, generating sanctioned revenue for the regime. Target: US Fortune 500 technology companies. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] CrowdStrike: DPRK's FAMOUS CHOLLIMA used GenAI to infiltrate 320+ companies as IT workers
item.description: CrowdStrike's 2025 Threat Hunting Report said North Korea's FAMOUS CHOLLIMA used generative AI across its insider scheme, from fake resumes and deepfaked interviews to on-the-job work, infiltrating 320+ firms in a year. Target: More than 320 companies employing remote IT contractors. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] LameHug: APT28-linked malware queries Qwen LLM to generate commands
item.description: CERT-UA reported phishing that delivered LameHug, a Python stealer using Qwen 2.5-Coder via Hugging Face's API to craft recon and theft commands, attributed to APT28 with moderate confidence. Target: Ukrainian government bodies. UA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] OpenAI bans APT15 and APT5 accounts using ChatGPT for pentest automation and US recon
item.description: Chinese state groups Vixen Panda (APT15) and Keyhole Panda (APT5) used ChatGPT for script edits, system configuration, pentest automation and Android social-media tooling while researching US defence and telecom targets. Target: US defence and telecom infrastructure. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI bans China-linked Peer Review network building Qianyue social-media monitoring tool
item.description: Accounts likely in China used ChatGPT to write sales copy, debug code and analyse documents for the Qianyue Overseas Public Opinion AI Assistant, a Llama-based tool reporting on Western protests to Chinese authorities. Target: Western social-media users organising anti-China protests. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Kimsuky and BlueNoroff used ChatGPT to debug RDP brute-force code and research intrusion
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts linked to North Korea's Kimsuky and BlueNoroff that gathered information on cyber intrusion tools and cryptocurrency topics and debugged code for RDP brute-force attacks. Target: Cryptocurrency and intrusion targets of North Korean groups. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI disrupts North Korean IT-worker accounts writing fake resumes and interview scripts
item.description: ChatGPT accounts tied to the DPRK IT-worker scheme produced resumes, profiles and cover letters plus scripted excuses for suspicious behaviour such as avoiding video; some applications were posted on LinkedIn. Target: Western companies hiring remote developers. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Storm-1516 floods German election with 100+ AI-written fake news sites and deepfakes
item.description: CORRECTIV and NewsGuard exposed a Russian network of more than 100 German-language fake news sites filled with LLM-rewritten articles and deepfake videos smearing Habeck, Baerbock and Faber before the February 2025 vote. Target: German Bundestag election candidates and voters. DE. Verification: confirmed.
